newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 10.

text.p: -- Compaq Computer Corp reported second quarter earnings of $1.48 per share, excluding a $0.73 per share charge. On a diluted basis, it earned $0.75 per share compared to $0.96 a year earlier. The First Call consensus earnings estimate was $1.39 per share. Compaq revenues rose to $5.01 billion from $4 billion a year earlier. The company said its outlook continued to call for a strong second half. The stock closed at 121-1/8 Wednesday.

-- Apple Computer Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Gilbert Amelio resigned after struggling for 17 months to return the company to profitability. The computer maker said it had started looking for a new CEO and that co-founder Steve Jobs would assume an expanded role until one was found. The stock closed at 13-11/16.

-- Seagate Technology Inc reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.61 per share diluted, excluding $155.5 million in one-time charges, compared with $0.52 a year earlier. Analysts had expected the computer disk drive maker to earn $0.66 per share, according to First Call. The stock last traded at 39-1/16.

-- Anadarko Petroleum Corp Chairman Robert Allison told the Wall Street Journal the company would report second quarter earnings below analysts' estimates of $0.29 per share and that the company had made a potentially significant oil find in Algeria. Anadarko closed at 62-1/8.
-- Hewlett-Packard Co plans to cut prices on commercial desktop computers by as much as 24 percent, beginning next week, the New York Times said. Hewlett closed at 57-15/16.
